div.h1: A community hub for TRE™ practitioners in Singapore
div.p: TRE™ in Singapore was established by Isabelle Claus Teixeira, a Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer active in Singapore and worldwide. It exists to make TRE™ easy to find, safe to learn and rewarding to teach.

Singapore is one of the most demanding places in the world to live and work. TRE™ offers something rare here: a body-based practice that is simple, science-backed and self-empowering — you learn it once and keep it for life.
This platform brings together everyone who makes that possible:

li.span: Certified providers offering individual and group sessions, online and face-to-face
Trainees moving through the Global TRE™ Provider Certification
Allied professionals — coaches, therapists, HR leaders and movement teachers — integrating TRE™ into their work
First-timers who simply want to feel calmer, sleep better and recover faster

div.h2: From Fortune 100 boardrooms to the mat
div.p: Isabelle Claus Teixeira spent more than 30 years as a Senior HR Business Partner and Talent Management leader in Fortune 100 companies across nine countries, collaborating with over 40 nationalities. Along the way she experienced first-hand what toxic work environments do to a body — and healed herself through somatic practice, TRE™ and mindfulness. That experience became her second career.

article.p: Began practising TRE™ in 2017, became a Certified TRE™ Provider in 2019 and a Global TRE™ Certifying Trainer in 2025 — accredited by the TRE™ For All organisation under Dr. David Berceli's methodology. Trained with David Berceli, Michelle Beck, Ching Meoh Cheong and Donna Philips.

ICF PCC-level certified executive coach since 2012 with more than 12 years of coaching experience across Southeast Asia, India, Singapore, Japan, the UK, the USA, Russia and Europe. Trained in Strozzi somatic bodywork and continuously studying transformational coaching, breathwork and trauma-informed techniques.
Trained as a Mindfulness Teacher in 2024 by Nick Cole, founder of the UK College of Mindful Meditation, and certified as an Accredited Usui/Holy Fire III Reiki healer in the William Lee Rand lineage.

li.p: Discovers TRE™ while recovering from burnout; begins a daily practice.
Starts teaching individuals and groups in Singapore, Japan and online.
Completes teacher training with the UK College of Mindful Meditation.
Begins running the full three-module certification in Singapore and launches this hub.

div.p: French by nationality, Isabelle is fluent in French, English and Spanish and conversant in Japanese and German. She has lived in ten countries — including ten years in Singapore — and is now a Japanese Permanent Resident based in Keihoku, north of Kyoto, travelling regularly to Singapore for certification modules, workshops and group sessions.

article.p: Every practice we teach — TRE™, coaching and mindfulness — is rooted in polyvagal theory and somatic neuroscience.
You never need to talk about what happened. You control the intensity, and you can stop at any moment.
All providers listed here hold or are working towards certification under the worldwide TRE™ programme.
Practice circles, supervision and referrals keep Singapore's TRE™ practitioners connected and growing.

div.h2: Business & Human Development Consulting Pte Ltd
div.p: TRE™ in Singapore is operated by Business & Human Development Consulting Pte Ltd (BHD Asia), a Singapore-registered boutique consultancy for HR, executive coaching and resilience building. Its wellbeing practice, HummingBeing, hosts our events and certification registrations.
